user.title: Charging Stations Switzerland (ich-tanke-strom.ch)
user.description: Choose what to set up: a live-filterable overview of all stations within a radius, or a single favorite station tracked independently of any location.

radius.title: Radius overview
radius.description: Sets up charging station tracking around a location, sourced from the official Swiss ich-tanke-strom.ch platform (BFE / EnergieSchweiz / swisstopo). Latitude/longitude default to your Home Assistant home location. Add the integration again for a different radius or location. Filters (minimum power, plug type, status, operator) are adjusted afterwards live via number/select entities. The radius is capped at 30 km — larger areas make the source server slow (20-40+ s per fetch) and would flood Home Assistant with thousands of entities.

data.chargeprice_api_key: Chargeprice API key (optional — free demo key: insights.chargeprice.app/signup?demo=true). Adds min/max CHF/kWh per station and a cheapest-charger sensor.

favorite.title: Favorite station
favorite.description: Enter the station's EvseID directly (e.g. from a QR code on the charger, or looked up on ich-tanke-strom.ch), or leave it empty and search near a location instead — you'll get a list to pick from on the next screen. Add the integration again for another favorite.

data.station_id: Station EvseID or whole-site ChargingStationId (optional — leave empty to search instead)
data.latitude: Latitude (used only if EvseID is empty)
data.longitude: Longitude (used only if EvseID is empty)
data.radius_km: Search radius (km, max. 30 — used only if EvseID is empty)
data.min_power_kw: Minimum power (kW, used only if EvseID is empty)
data.plug_type: Plug type (used only if EvseID is empty)

favorite_pick.title: Pick your favorite station
favorite_pick.description: {count} stations found nearby, closest first. Entries marked with 📍 are whole sites (all charge points there combined into one favorite) instead of a single connector.

favorite_scope.title: One charge point or the whole site?
favorite_scope.description: {evse_id} is one of {count} charge points at {site}. Pin only this charge point, or the whole site with all its charge points?

favorite_confirm.title: Confirm favorite
favorite_confirm.description: Found: {what}. You can give it a custom name before it is created.

abort.already_configured: This location/radius or station is already configured.

error.station_not_found: No station with this EvseID was found.
error.no_stations_found: No stations found within this radius.
error.no_evse_id: This station has no EvseID and can't be tracked as a favorite.

init.title: Options
init.description:
Plug type sensors: each selected plug type gets its own sensor counting the available charge points of that type in this radius. These respect the minimum-power and operator filters but ignore the live plug-type and status filters.

Chargeprice (optional): an API key adds structured prices for most networks (free demo key: insights.chargeprice.app/signup?demo=true). Without a key, the cheapest-price sensor uses the published ad-hoc prices from the BFE price atlas.

data.plug_type_sensors: Plug types with a dedicated sensor
data.chargeprice_api_key: Chargeprice API key (optional, leave empty to disable)

abort.no_options: Only radius entries have options. Favorites are configured when they are added.
